title.en: Execute a Morpho Vault V2 adapter cap increase (after the timelock ends)
title.zh-TW: 執行 Morpho Vault V2 轉接合約上限的提高（timelock 到期後）

summary.en: The Safe calls the vault's `multicall` to execute two calls queued earlier with `submit` whose timelock has ended: raise the absolute cap of the vault's market adapter to the amount you type, and its relative cap to the percentage you type. It moves none of the Safe's assets.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 vault 的 `multicall`，執行之前 `submit` 排好、timelock 已到期的兩個呼叫：把 vault 的市場轉接合約的絕對上限提高到你填的數量，相對上限提高到你填的百分比。不動 Safe 的任何資產。

intro.en: Morpho Vault V2 spreads deposits across several Morpho Blue markets. The curator sets how much each market can hold (its cap), and the allocator moves funds within the caps. Raising a cap takes a `submit` first, and it can run only after the timelock has passed.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 把存款分配到多個 Morpho Blue 市場。curator 設定每個市場能放多少（上限），allocator 在上限內搬錢。提高上限要先 `submit`，等 timelock 過了才能執行。

text.en: Vault V2's GitHub lists 10 audits (Spearbit, Zellic, Blackthorn, ChainSecurity, Certora and one contest).
text.zh-TW: Vault V2 的 GitHub 列了 10 份稽核（Spearbit、Zellic、Blackthorn、ChainSecurity、Certora 和一場競賽）。

text.en: Anyone can execute: once the timelock ends, any address can send these two calls; the contract checks only `executableAt`. The caps you type must be exactly the ones in the original `submit`, or the vault reverts.
text.zh-TW: 執行不限誰：timelock 到期後任何地址都能送出這兩個呼叫，合約只檢查 `executableAt`。你填的上限必須跟當初 `submit` 的一模一樣，不然 vault 會 revert。

recommendation.en: Type the numbers from the original submit. verify confirms that after the transaction both caps equal what you typed.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照當初 submit 的數字填；verify 確認交易後兩個上限都等於你填的。

text.en: This template accepts only the vault's own registry `adapter`, with the absolute and the relative cap in one `multicall`, the shape established curators sent (7 such transactions in the recent history of 265 curator Safes). Several ids in one transaction get MISMATCH from verify.
text.zh-TW: 這個模板只收 vault 登錄的 `adapter`，絕對和相對上限放在一個 `multicall`，這是成熟 curator 送的寫法（265 個 curator Safe 近期的交易裡 7 筆）。一筆執行好幾個 id，verify 會判 MISMATCH。

recommendation.en: Put one id in each transaction. On MISMATCH, do not sign.
recommendation.zh-TW: 一筆只放一個 id；判 MISMATCH 就不要簽。

role.en: The vault's asset; the absolute cap is counted in it
role.zh-TW: vault 的資產，絕對上限用它計算

role.en: The factory that creates Vault V2 market adapters. It answers `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true: it created the adapter
role.zh-TW: 建立 Vault V2 市場轉接合約的工廠，它回答 `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true，轉接合約是它建立的

1.multicall.data.en: The two calls the vault runs in order, fixed at two items: the absolute cap first, then the relative cap. If either fails, the whole transaction fails.
1.multicall.data.zh-TW: vault 依序執行的兩個呼叫，固定兩項：先絕對上限，再相對上限。任一個失敗，整筆失敗。

1.multicall.data[0].en: Item 1: execute the queued absolute cap increase.
1.multicall.data[0].zh-TW: 第一項：執行已排隊的絕對上限提高。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "the whole adapter".
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 上限的編號資料。vault 用它的 keccak256 當上限的 id，這裡是「整個轉接合約」。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The kind of id, fixed to this: a cap on everything the vault puts through this adapter, not on one market or one collateral token.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this：vault 經由這個轉接合約放出去的全部，不是單一市場或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets; its registry `adapter`.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場；就是登錄的 `adapter`。

1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..en: The new absolute cap: the most assets the vault can put into the adapter. It must equal the number queued earlier.
1.multicall.data[0].increaseAbsoluteCap..zh-TW: 新的絕對上限：vault 最多放多少資產進轉接合約，必須等於當初排隊的數字。

1.multicall.data[1].en: Item 2: execute the queued relative cap increase.
1.multicall.data[1].zh-TW: 第二項：執行已排隊的相對上限提高。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "the whole adapter".
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: 上限的編號資料。vault 用它的 keccak256 當上限的 id，這裡是「整個轉接合約」。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The kind of id, fixed to this: a cap on everything the vault puts through this adapter, not on one market or one collateral token.
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this：vault 經由這個轉接合約放出去的全部，不是單一市場或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets; its registry `adapter`.
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場；就是登錄的 `adapter`。

1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..en: The new relative cap: the largest share of the vault's total assets the adapter can hold. It must equal the number queued earlier.
1.multicall.data[1].increaseRelativeCap..zh-TW: 新的相對上限：轉接合約最多占 vault 總資產的比例，必須等於當初排隊的數字。
